title: NeuroWare Catalyst Fund launches for neuromorphic technology translation
summary: The NeuroWare organization launched the NeuroWare Catalyst Fund to support researchers in translating neuromorphic technologies from laboratory research toward real-world applications. The flexible funding scheme covers translational activities including early-stage scoping, feasibility studies, and technology validation. Projects must demonstrate a pathway towards adoption or commercialisation. An applicant webinar was scheduled for 2026-09-17T14:00+01:00 to explain the application process.
tldr: NeuroWare launched a funding scheme in September 2026 to help researchers translate neuromorphic technologies from lab to real-world applications via feasibility studies and validation projects.
evidence: The fund will support a range of translational activities, from early-stage scoping and feasibility studies through to technology validation.

trl.evidence: projects expected to demonstrate a clear pathway towards adoption
